name: detent-dial
title: Detent Dial
description: A rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch, with a swelling tick ring, flick momentum and a rolling readout.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, also shown inside the knob.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled. Double-clicking the knob returns here.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called each time the dial crosses into a new notch.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the readout, the end labels and aria-valuetext.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dragging, keys and the wheel.
